economic_verdict: The exact published selected tape necessarily retains positive small-risk value under the reported continuous sizing assumptions.
Its small-risk geometric growth is bounded far below the 1% daily objective, so it is an Expansion component rather than a sufficient Core engine.
The 5% headline materially amplifies both gains and the 2026H1 regime loss; it does not create a new information source.
The exact model cannot be independently audited from the repository because source, scored candidates, trades and daily NAV are represented only by hashes.
A nearby reproducible HGBT and a robust bootstrap-LCB screen show that model specification and tail selection are economically decisive.
Preserve the route provisionally as Expansion; do not grant deployment authority or tune with 2026-aware thresholds, channel lookbacks, risk or leverage.
